# Shrink Reduction Plan — FY26

- **Goal / definition of done:** reduce store shrink from the last audit's **1.9%** back **under the 1.4%
  target** by the next physical inventory (**January 2027**), with measurable improvement visible at the
  quarterly LP audit.
- **Owner:** Marc, executed day-to-day by [Jordan Alvarez](../people/jordan-alvarez.md) (AM Ops), partnered
  with [Victor Hultgren](../people/victor-hultgren.md) (District LP).
- **Status:** **active, top priority.** [Renata Vasquez](../people/renata-vasquez.md) reviews it weekly.
- **Workstreams:**
  - **Exception reports** — tighten refund/void/no-sale controls at the register (front-end, with Tanya).
  - **Receiving/back-door** — verify deliveries against manifests; control the baler/RTV dock.
  - **Footwear** — the highest-shrink category; more cycle counts with [Danny Okafor](../people/danny-okafor.md).
- **Open items:** submit the **Q3 shrink action plan** to Victor (commitment — **was due 2026-06-30, still open**).
- **Reference:** cycle counts run every Tuesday; see [Operations](../context/operations.md).
